reason: All policy requirements for canceling a pending order are satisfied: (1) Order status is 'pending' per the order details retrieved at message index 6; (2) User has been authenticated via email at message indices 3-4, and order ownership verified at message index 5; (3) Cancellation reason 'ordered by mistake' is one of the two acceptable reasons listed in policy; (4) User provided explicit confirmation at message index 13 after the agent listed action details at message index 12.
policy_references: An order can only be cancelled if its status is 'pending', and you should check its status before taking the action.
The user needs to confirm the order id and the reason (either 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake') for cancellation.
Before taking any action that updates the database (cancel, modify, return, exchange), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.
